name: cyrelle
description: Cyrelle — global women-only social platform, free business profiles, appointments, safety, and advertising.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @cyrelle/shared && npm run build --workspace @cyrelle/api && npm run build --workspace @cyrelle/web && npm run build --workspace @cyrelle/admin
